thread:
lucas: hey team - Lucas here, started in eng-runtime. quick mapping q: who owns the "who-to-ask" matrix for first-week infra stuff? need network, deploy, and monitoring perms for a demo next week and want to avoid pinging the wrong folks. any single doc or owner to route to?
jamie (People Ops): welcome @lucas! :tada: People Ops maintains the high-level onboarding checklist but infra and platform own the actual perms. i can route urgent demo tickets if you mark them demo-priority.
erin (eng-infra): infra owns VPC/subnet/SG requests and network-level ACLs. open a ticket in #help with subject "vpc-onboard: <name>" and include github handle, subnet cidr, and demo expiry. tag @erin and @infra-oncall for faster handling. SLA usually 24h for simple requests.
dave (platform): platform handles deploy roles, registry ACLs, and model-serving pins. DM me your GitHub handle + repo and ill pre-stage the redwood-dedicated deployer role. if youre demo-blocked i can issue a short-lived deploy token valid until EOD on demo day.
sara (eng-manager): from a manager perspective, if this is customer-facing please cc me and page PagerDuty if infra stalls. also check the runbook at https://kb.redwood.ai/onboard/who-to-ask - it lists owners by resource.
\alonboard-bot: Request received (id:onb-2149990010). You will get updates here.
lucas: super helpful - does anyone maintain a single "owner matrix" doc so i can bookmark it?
jamie (People Ops): yes, we have an internal owners spreadsheet (read-only) linked from the onboarding hub. i'll DM the link to you. it lists primary owners, backups, and PagerDuty policies.
erin (eng-infra): quick cheat-sheet: network -> infra, deploy/registry -> platform, db/read-only -> eng-sre, vault/tokens -> security. for demo escalations, page infra-oncall and cc People Ops + your manager.
dave (platform): plus: feature flags -> product/feature-flags team; datadog/APM -> observability team. if you tell me the exact checks you need for the demo i can preflight the permissions.
lucas: thanks all - filing the tickets now and DMing @dave my repo. appreciate the quick orientation :raised_hands:
